system.description:
Embraced in the modern age, your blood is thinner than even most Caitiff's, no more than five years undead and created by a 13th-generation sire. You have 10 Blood Traits but can use only eight; the other two are inert, treated as mortal blood.

You must take the Flaw: Thin Blood (still gaining its Free Traits), are almost certainly Caitiff, and may not take the Generation Background.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
